lines.t: The word came in, silence broke, like light in the dark, like light in the dark
Every hidden thing
Like barren as fire
He got me awake
Fire in my bones
Voice like thunder
Breaking every stone
Truth in the word when he speaks
Life in the breath when he breathes
Spirit on fire All, all, all the lies exposed
All, all, all the lies exposed
Every page burned like a warning inside me
Words say stay asleep, but the truth come and find me
Truth cut deep, set me apart He got me awake, fire in my bones
Voice like thunder, breaking every stone Truth in the word when he speaks
Life in the breath when he breathes Spirit on fire
All the lies exposed All the lies exposed
If I fall, you still remain Wash me clean in the holy rain
Hands lifted high when you call Life in the breath when you fall
Bye-bye.
Thanks for watching!
